title: Families of actual tensor support rows
statement: For categories C,D with zero morphisms in D, RowFamily C D is a function assigning a short complex in D to each object of C, together with a map of short complexes for every arrow of C. For two such families S,T, a predicate R(I,m) on their connecting maps, and m:S(I)→T(I), DiagramNatural S T R I m means that S(f) followed by every m' satisfying R(I',m') equals m followed by T(f). For ordinary etale support data [def-pur-etale-kflat-support-data] on a closed-open pair i:Z→P,j:U→P, supportSequenceFamily assigns the actual support sequence and its existing map. Given a complex Q and an endofunctor F, topSequenceFamily assigns the support row tensored by Q; bottomSequenceFamily assigns the support row of F(Q⊗I). Their arrow assignments are respectively tensor of the given support arrow and the support arrow induced by F(Q⊗f). These are existing constructions packaged as data, with no additional axioms or chosen witnesses. The generic tensorRow and tensorRowMap apply the supplied tensor-left functor. IsComparison says that the second and third components are heterogeneously equal to eta and the canonical OpenSupport.rightMap; the endpoints are definitionally the same complexes.
